checks.result: Launched the actual project-bound stdio server and discovered exactly eight tools in 6720 UTF-8 JSON bytes. Five read tools preserved every persistent database table and all seven Source fingerprints; project work/readiness/search and the active-session L1 context were consumed through MCP. The initial/after-evidence contexts used 4977/4972 tokens and were complete. An actual development observation and evidence record were appended through MCP, preserving the main session/claim and source files. Seven tools have been used at this report point; the separately recorded completion workflow exercises the eighth tool. This report does not preclaim that later completion result.

limitations: Feature-local verification and development self-use only; agent-specific adapters, centralized regression/security, real-client E4 scenarios, metrics and release remain scheduled.
This is a project-bound local stdio server. Session/claim/branch lifecycle and detailed drill-down remain CLI operations so the MCP catalog stays at eight tools.

Readonly requests use a private SQLite memory snapshot capped at 256 MiB, with source observations before/after and a live project revision check. The memory/search scaling targets are not yet benchmarked.
Evidence registration stores caller assertions. Only the existing completion domain validates referenced report bytes and bindings; neither metadata nor tests certify E4 business quality.
Cancellation or loss of a transport response does not prove a mutation rolled back; inspect durable receipts before retrying.
